RebelMyReports.AvailableForAllWebsitesHelp: Custom dimensions and goal metrics only exist for one website and cannot be used. This cannot be changed after the report is created.
RebelMyReports.CalculatedMetricsIntro: Define your own metrics as a formula over other metrics, for example pages per visit. A calculated metric can be used in any report of this website.
RebelMyReports.DeleteMetricConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the calculated metric "%s"?
RebelMyReports.DeleteReportConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the report "%s"? Its archived data will no longer be available.
RebelMyReports.DocApi: Everything on these pages can also be done through the Reporting API. See the API reference:
RebelMyReports.DocArchive: Reports are archived by Matomo's normal archiving. The list of reports shows for which days a report has data and whether more is waiting to be archived.
RebelMyReports.DocArchiveCommand: To archive reports right away from the command line:
RebelMyReports.DocArchiveInvalidate: A super user can have the data of reports built again for a period, without the command line:
RebelMyReports.DocArchiveTimeout: When a query runs longer than the time limit, the report gets no data for that period, and the list of reports tells which period it was. Make the report lighter or raise the limit, then invalidate the period.
RebelMyReports.DocCombine: Not all dimensions and metrics can be combined. The editor tells you when a combination is not possible.
RebelMyReports.DocCreate: Open My Reports > Manage reports in the reporting menu of a website and choose "Create new report". You need write access to the website.
RebelMyReports.DocCreateEdit: Give the report a name, choose a type, add metrics and, for a table, dimensions. While you edit, the preview shows the first rows for yesterday.
RebelMyReports.DocFirstData: A new report gets its data the next time reports are archived, for the last %s months.
RebelMyReports.DocIntro: My Reports lets you build your own reports from the dimensions and metrics Matomo collects. A report is archived like Matomo's own reports, so it loads fast and works with segments, date ranges, comparisons, export, scheduled email reports and dashboards.
RebelMyReports.DocLimits: A super user sets the limits under Administration > System > General settings. A value in the [RebelMyReports] section of config.ini.php is used instead of the setting. These are the limits now:
RebelMyReports.DocMetrics: On the Manage reports page you can define your own metrics as a formula over other metrics, and use them in any report of the website. A formula uses metric IDs with + - * / and parentheses:
RebelMyReports.DocMetricsRates: Rates and averages cannot be used in a formula. Use the metrics they are calculated from.
RebelMyReports.DocRows: Sorting, the row limit and metric filters, for example only rows with at least 10 visits, change how the archived data is shown and not the data itself. A row has to pass all metric filters. For a rate, enter 0.5 for 50%.
RebelMyReports.DocSegmentFilter: The filter of a report restricts it to the visits that match. Changing the filter, the dimensions or the metrics builds the data of the report again.
RebelMyReports.DocShowElsewhere: Each report is also a dashboard widget, can be exported, and can be added to scheduled email reports.
RebelMyReports.DocShowManage: A super user can make a report available for all websites. Pausing a report keeps its data but archives nothing new. Duplicating copies a report, also to another website.
RebelMyReports.DocShowOrder: Drag the reports in the list to change their order in the menu and on a page they share.
RebelMyReports.DocShowPage: A report gets a page of its own under My Reports. You can instead place it in another reporting category, or on an existing page together with other reports.
RebelMyReports.DocTypeEvolution: Evolution: metrics over time, without dimensions.
RebelMyReports.DocTypeKeyFigure: Key figure: one metric as a number, with the change since the previous period.
RebelMyReports.DocTypeTable: Table: one or more dimensions, at most %s. Each dimension after the first becomes a level below the rows of the one before it.
RebelMyReports.DocValueGroups: Value groups count several values of a dimension as one row, for example a few countries as one region or all page URLs that start with /blog as "Blog". The values are grouped when the report is archived, so visits and unique visitors are counted correctly for the group. Changing the groups builds the data of the report again.
RebelMyReports.DocValueGroupsHow: In the editor, under the dimensions, choose "Add a group", give it a name and pick the dimension. Then add its values one by one: choose a value from the suggestions, or type it and press Enter. Values are compared as Matomo stores them, for example "se" for Sweden; the suggestions show the readable name next to it.
RebelMyReports.DocValueGroupsRules: The operator applies to all values of a group: are, contain, start with or end with. A value that matches several groups is counted in the first one. A report can have at most 50 groups with 200 values each.
RebelMyReports.DocVisualization: A table report can open as a table, a bar graph, a pie chart or a tag cloud. Graphs show the first level of a report with several dimensions. Whoever views the report can still switch in its footer.
RebelMyReports.ErrorDescription: The description can have at most %s characters.
RebelMyReports.ErrorFilterOperator: The operator of the metric filter must be one of: %s.
RebelMyReports.ErrorFilterValue: The value of a metric filter must be a number.
RebelMyReports.ErrorFormulaMetric: The formula uses "%s", which is not a metric that can be used in formulas. Rates and averages cannot be used; use the metrics they are calculated from.
RebelMyReports.ErrorFormulaNeedsMetric: The formula needs at least one metric.
RebelMyReports.ErrorKeyFigureNeedsOneMetric: A key figure shows exactly one metric.
RebelMyReports.ErrorMetricFormat: The format must be one of: %s.
RebelMyReports.ErrorMetricInUse: This metric is used by these reports and cannot be deleted: %s.
RebelMyReports.ErrorMetricName: The metric needs a name of at most %s characters.
RebelMyReports.ErrorMetricNotFound: There is no calculated metric with ID %s for this website.
RebelMyReports.ErrorName: The report needs a name of at most %s characters.
RebelMyReports.ErrorNoDimensionsAllowed: Only a table report can have dimensions.
RebelMyReports.ErrorNoMetric: A report needs at least one metric.
RebelMyReports.ErrorNotCombinable: These dimensions and metrics cannot be combined in one report (tables: %s).
RebelMyReports.ErrorOrderAllWebsites: Only a super user can move a report that is available for all websites.
RebelMyReports.ErrorPage: The reporting page "%s" does not exist in this category.
RebelMyReports.ErrorReportNotFound: There is no report with ID %s for this website.
RebelMyReports.ErrorReportOrder: The order must name each report of the website once.
RebelMyReports.ErrorReportType: The report type must be "table", "evolution" or "keyfigure".
RebelMyReports.ErrorRowLimit: The row limit cannot be negative.
RebelMyReports.ErrorRowMetric: "%s" is not a metric of the report, so its rows cannot be sorted or filtered by it.
RebelMyReports.ErrorSettingRange: Enter a whole number of at least 1. If there is a highest value, it is: %s
RebelMyReports.ErrorSiteSpecific: "%s" only exists for this website and cannot be used in a report for all websites.
RebelMyReports.ErrorSortOrder: The sort order must be "asc" or "desc".
RebelMyReports.ErrorTableNeedsDimension: A table report needs at least one dimension.
RebelMyReports.ErrorTooManyDimensions: A report can have at most %s dimensions.
RebelMyReports.ErrorTooManyValueGroups: A report can have at most %s value groups.
RebelMyReports.ErrorValueGroup: A value group needs a dimension of the report, a group name, an operator (%s) and at least one value.
RebelMyReports.ErrorVisualization: The visualization must be one of: %s.
RebelMyReports.ExampleChannelsDescription: A calculated metric shown as a bar graph: pages per visit, with the formula pageviews / nb_visits, for each channel type.
RebelMyReports.ExampleCountriesDescription: Two dimensions: open a country to see its browsers. The row limit keeps the 10 rows with the most visits on each level.
RebelMyReports.ExampleEntryPagesDescription: Two metric filters: only entry pages with at least 10 visits and a bounce rate above 50%, sorted by bounce rate.
RebelMyReports.ExampleRegionsDescription: A value group: the Nordic countries are counted as one row, "Nordics", and the other countries stay as they are.
RebelMyReports.ExampleReturningDescription: An evolution report with a filter: only the visits of returning visitors are counted.
RebelMyReports.ExampleVisitsDescription: A key figure: one number with the change since the previous period, also useful as a dashboard widget.
RebelMyReports.ExamplesIntro: Create an example to see how a function works. It becomes a normal report of the website "%s" that you can change or delete.
RebelMyReports.FormulaHelp: Use metric IDs with + - * / and parentheses, for example: pageviews / nb_visits. Rates and averages cannot be used in a formula; use the metrics they are calculated from.
RebelMyReports.InsertMetric: Insert a metric into the formula
RebelMyReports.InvalidateAllSegments: All visits and every archived segment
RebelMyReports.InvalidateDone: Reports marked as outdated: %s. Their data is built again the next time reports are archived.
RebelMyReports.InvalidateIntro: Mark the archived data of reports as outdated for a period. It stays visible until it is built again, the next time reports are archived. Paused reports are left alone.
RebelMyReports.InvalidatePeriodHelp: A week, month or year is the one that contains the date. Days in the future are skipped.
RebelMyReports.KeyFigureHelp: A key figure shows the value of a single metric, with a sparkline and the change since the previous period.
RebelMyReports.ManageReportsIntro: Build your own reports from any combination of dimensions and metrics. A new report gets its data the next time reports are archived.
RebelMyReports.MaxDimensionsReached: A report can have at most %s dimensions.
RebelMyReports.MaxMetricsReached: Remove the metric to choose another one.
RebelMyReports.NewPageForReport: A new page named after the report
RebelMyReports.NoCalculatedMetricsYet: There are no calculated metrics yet.
RebelMyReports.Pause: Pause: keep the data, archive nothing new
RebelMyReports.PreviewHint: The first rows for yesterday, queried live. The saved report can differ slightly.
RebelMyReports.PreviewNeedsMetric: Add a metric to see a preview.
RebelMyReports.PreviewSlow: The preview took %s seconds for one day. A report like this can slow down archiving.
RebelMyReports.PreviewTimeout: The preview was stopped after %s seconds. A report like this is slow to archive. Add a segment filter or use fewer dimensions.
RebelMyReports.ProblemFailed: %s could not be archived. The Matomo log has the error.
RebelMyReports.ProblemTimeout: %s was not archived: a query ran longer than the time limit. Add a segment filter or use fewer dimensions.
RebelMyReports.ProblemTruncated: %s has more rows than a report reads. The rows with the lowest values are missing.
RebelMyReports.Reorder: Drag the report, or press the arrow up or down key here, to move it. This is also the order of the pages in the menu and of reports that share a page.
RebelMyReports.ReportPageHelp: Add the report to an existing page of the category, or give it a page of its own.
RebelMyReports.ReportSaved: The report was saved. Its data is added the next time reports are archived.
RebelMyReports.RowLimitHelp: How many rows of each level are kept after sorting. 0 keeps all rows.
RebelMyReports.RowsHelp: These settings change how the archived data is shown, not the data itself. For a rate, enter 0.5 for 50%.
RebelMyReports.SegmentFilterHelp: Only visits matching this filter are counted in the report.
RebelMyReports.SettingMaxExecutionTime: Seconds a query that archives a report may run
RebelMyReports.SettingMaxExecutionTimeHelp: A report whose query is stopped gets no data for that period, and the list of reports tells which period it was.
RebelMyReports.SettingMaxRowsHelp: Per day, week, month and year. The rest is summed into one row. A new limit applies to what is archived from then on.
RebelMyReports.SettingMaxRowsSubtableHelp: The same limit for the rows below each row of a report with several dimensions.
RebelMyReports.SettingPreviewMaxExecutionTime: Seconds a query of the preview may run
RebelMyReports.SettingPreviewMaxExecutionTimeHelp: The preview in the report editor is stopped after this time.
RebelMyReports.UpdateWarning: This changes the data of the report. When you save, the data archived for it so far becomes unavailable and is built again for the last %s months.
RebelMyReports.ValueGroupsHelp: Count several values of a dimension as one row, for example Sweden, Norway and Denmark as "Nordics". Add each value of a group by choosing it from the suggestions, or type it and press Enter. Values are compared as Matomo stores them, for example "se" for Sweden. The first group a value matches decides.
RebelMyReports.VisualizationHelp: What the report opens as. Whoever views it can still switch in the footer of the report.
RebelMyReports.WaitingToBeArchived: More is waiting to be archived
